## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Database Performance and Usability Test Suite

**Target System:** Virtual Health Platform

**Target Version:** 2.5

**Test Objective:** To ensure the Virtual Health Platform can handle a 3-year database with 4.0 Million Consultation requests and cater to 250,000 unique Patients with 5 specialities by the end of year 3, while being adaptable to mobile platforms and user interface design with usability in mind.

**Test Scope:**

* Database performance testing with 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years.
* Usability testing of user interfaces for mobile platforms.

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Title | Requirement ID | Test Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Database Performance Test | VIRTUA-2.5-10 | Performance | Database is initialized with 4.0 Million Consultation requests. | None | Run performance tests for 3 years. | System should handle the load without errors or performance degradation. |
| TC-002 | Database Design for Growth | VIRTUA-2.5-14 | Functional | None | None | System is designed to support future growth in Consultation requests. | Database schema should be scalable to accommodate additional Consultation requests. |
| TC-003 | Mobile Platform Compatibility | VIRTUA-2.5-15 | Functional | None | None | System is designed to run on mobile platforms (Android). | Mobile application should be functional and compatible with Android devices. |
| TC-004 | Adaptive User Interface | VIRTUA-2.5-16 | Functional | None | None | User interface is designed with adaptive response in mind. | User interface should adjust automatically to different screen sizes and resolutions. |
| TC-005 | Usability Testing | VIRTUA-2.5-17 | Usability | None | None | Usability testing is conducted with different user groups. | System should be easy to use and navigate, with clear labels and instructions. |
